title: Canadian Corn Casserole
description: A classic Canadian casserole dish featuring sweet corn, warm spices, and a crispy topping.
instructions: In a skillet, cook the crumbled bacon until crispy. Remove from heat and set aside.
In the same skillet, sauté the chopped onion and minced garlic until softened.
Add the frozen corn to the skillet and cook until thawed.
In a separate bowl, mix together the flour, milk, and shredded cheddar cheese until smooth.
Add the cooked bacon, onion, and corn mixture to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Top the casserole with additional shredded cheddar cheese and dot with butter.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is hot and bubbly.
